Key observations from the test image:
- Large yellow/orange lesion at the leaf tip with dark brown-black necrotic tissue
- V-shaped pattern of yellowing from leaf margin inward
- Some mottling of the remaining green tissue
- Small dark spots scattered on leaf

Top candidates: **Verticillium_Wilt** (V-shaped margin lesions), **Late_Blight** (brown blotches), **Target_Spot** (dark lesions with concentric rings).

The Verticillium_Wilt reference images (especially top-left panel) are nearly identical to the test image: same white background, same tomato leaf morphology, same V-shaped yellow lesion from the leaf margin with dark brown-black necrotic tissue at the tip, and similar mottling of remaining green tissue.

Late_Blight shows oily/water-soaked purple-brown blotches — doesn't match. Target_Spot shows discrete circular spots with concentric rings — doesn't match.
